set.title: End-market segmentation and the 2025-2026 AI/memory surge
questions: What are the WSTS end-use shares (computing, communications, consumer, automotive, industrial, government) for 2019-2025, and how does WSTS collect them?
How much of 2025-2026 growth is price vs volume, and memory vs logic vs other (WSTS product-level data)?
How do WSTS end-use shares compare with company segment disclosures (e.g. TSMC platform split CLM-0071)?
Which end markets are growing, flat or shrinking in units vs value?
subquestions: Is the WSTS end-use survey published annually and to whom?
How are AI accelerators classified by end use?
open_questions: Deep dives by end market sit in separate dynamics units (automotive/industrial, consumer, AI).

questions: What is the annual DRAM and NAND revenue and average-price time series (WSTS product data, company filings)?
How did the number of DRAM and NAND makers fall, via which exits (Qimonda 2009, Elpida 2012), mergers and government rescues?
What triggered each memory downturn (1985, 1996, 2001, 2008-09, 2012, 2019, 2023) and how deep was it?
What role did state support play (Korea, Japan's Elpida, China's CXMT/YMTC)?
subquestions: How did the 1986 US-Japan Semiconductor Arrangement affect DRAM prices?
primary_sources: Samsung and SK hynix business reports (DART)
Elpida reorganisation filings (Tokyo District Court, to verify)
open_questions: Current price mechanics and HBM contracting are in RU-0018; keep this unit historical.

questions: How large is AI-related semiconductor revenue (accelerators, HBM, networking, advanced packaging) by year 2022-2026, from company filings rather than forecasts?
Which companies capture it and with what margins (NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell, TSMC, SK hynix, Samsung, Micron)?
What bottlenecks emerged (CoWoS capacity, HBM supply, substrates, power) and how long did each last?
How has custom silicon (TPU, Trainium, MTIA) changed the split between merchant GPUs and ASICs?
How does this demand wave compare with the PC and smartphone waves?
subquestions: What share of TSMC revenue is AI accelerators per TSMC's own statements?
How are US export controls affecting AI chip sales to China?
primary_sources: NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell 10-K and earnings releases
SK hynix and Samsung business reports (DART)
open_questions: Overbuild risk is handled in the risks unit on cyclical and demand risk.

questions: How are DRAM and NAND priced (contract vs spot), with which customers, and how often renegotiated (quarterly/monthly)?
How do inventory write-downs, utilisation cuts and capex cuts transmit the cycle to profits (Micron, SK hynix, Samsung, Kioxia 2022-2024)?
How is HBM priced and contracted (annual volume/price agreements, prepayments), per company disclosures?
What happened to memory prices in 2025-2026 and why?
Which public price series track memory prices, and how reliable are they?
subquestions: Do memory makers disclose average-price changes quarterly (e.g. Micron bit shipments and ASP commentary)?
primary_sources: SK hynix and Samsung business reports (DART) and earnings calls
open_questions: Keep historical cycle narrative in RU-0012.

questions: What are TSMC, Samsung, Intel and Rapidus node roadmaps (N2/A16/A14, SF2, 18A/14A, 2nm) with dated production milestones per company statements?
How are DRAM (1c node, 4F2/3D DRAM) and NAND (layer counts) scaling, per memory makers?
How fast are SiC (200mm) and GaN (300mm, CLM-0411) moving to larger wafers?
What does IEEE IRDS say about roadmap limits and timing?
Which transitions change demand for specific tools and materials (High-NA EUV, hybrid bonding, backside power)?
primary_sources: Intel Foundry Direct Connect releases and 10-K
open_questions: Execution risk of transitions is covered by the technology-execution risk unit.

questions: What does a leading-edge PDK contain, and what agreements (NDA, PDK licence, export-control screening) govern access (INT-0016)?
How do EDA vendors, IP vendors and foundries certify tool flows and validate IP for a node (TSMC OIP, Samsung SAFE, Intel Foundry Accelerator)?
What exactly is handed over at tape-out (GDSII/OASIS, mask ordering data, job deck) and to whom, and how is it protected in transit?
How are export controls on EDA (REG-0011) applied to PDK and tool access?
How do open-source PDKs (SKY130, GF180, IHP) differ in access and content?
subquestions: Which foundry design-ecosystem programme pages list certified tools?
open_questions: Operational sequence (design stages, tape-out gates, mask turnaround) is in the new design-to-tape-out and tape-out-to-first-silicon workflow units; keep this unit on information content and access.
MPW question moved to the tape-out-to-first-silicon workflow.

set.title: Manufacturing and test data systems and standards: MES, FDC, SPC, yield management, test data formats and their vendors
questions: Which systems hold fab and test data (MES, FDC, SPC, APC, YMS, recipe management, test data) and who supplies them (Applied Materials SmartFactory, Siemens Opcenter/Camstar, Critical Manufacturing, PDF Solutions, KLA, Synopsys)?
Which data standards apply and what do they cover (SEMI E5 SECS-II, E30 GEM, E37 HSMS, E40/E94 job management, E142, E164, STDF V4, RITdb/SEMI E183)?
How much data does a fab generate and how long is it kept (CLM-0452 vendor estimate)?
Which steps remain manual?
subquestions: What is the market size of fab software (if public)?
primary_sources: SEMI standards catalog (E5, E30, E37, E40, E94, E142, E164, E183)
Siemens Opcenter and Applied SmartFactory product documentation
open_questions: Cross-company data sharing moved to the new information-flows unit 'Cross-company yield and quality data exchange'.

questions: How are demand forecasts, orders and capacity reservations exchanged between OEMs/Tier-1s, distributors, fabless firms, foundries and OSATs: formats (EDI, RosettaNet PIPs, portals, spreadsheets), horizons, frequency (INT-0014)?
How binding are forecasts (frozen zones, NCNR orders, take-or-pay, capacity reservation fees), per filings (e.g. NVIDIA purchase commitments CLM-0189, GlobalFoundries capacity reservation)?
What visibility initiatives exist (GAO-recommended voluntary data sharing CLM-0461, EU Chips Act monitoring, SEMI/SIA initiatives, commercial platforms)?
How did forecast behaviour (double-ordering) contribute to the 2021 shortage and 2023 glut?
Where are the manual steps?
subquestions: What are RosettaNet PIPs used in semiconductors (e.g. PIP 4A3/4A4 forecasts, to verify)?
Do automakers now share forecasts directly with foundries?
open_questions: Order-to-delivery workflow and allocation workflow are separate workflow units.

questions: What do US NAICS 334413 (and 2022 NAICS 334413 within 334410 group) and 333242, ISIC 2610, NACE 26.11, Japan JSIC, China GB/T 4754 and HS 8541/8542/8486 cover exactly?
Which official datasets are usable for output, employment and trade by classification, and what are their caveats (bundling with other components CLM-0020)?
How do official classifications map to WSTS product categories?
How did HS 2022 changes affect series continuity?
